summary: Move the usage-history relay's loopback producer parsing and bounded HTTP reads into a shared web-server module, with no behaviour change.

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild of persisted state.

schema.detail: No database, wire or client-v0 schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Routes, responses, deadlines, size limits and WF_USAGE_HISTORY_URL validation are unchanged. Only module-internal exports moved: the producer parser is now loopbackProducer(value, name) in server/relayHttp.mts.

downtime.detail: No startup or request-path work changes.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit; no persistent state changes.
